name: Wazuka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Wazuka town emblem in white: four interlocking outlined rings.
history: Municipal flag of Wazuka, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 1970.

features.role: Wazuka town emblem — four interlocking outlined rings
